text: The Abu Dhabi Sports Council was 'established in 2006 by His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, The president of United Arab Emirates' and 'is aligned to the emirate's leadership vision to develop sport and youth activities' - it is the Emirate of Abu Dhabi's government sports authority.
short: ADSC: established 2006 by Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed, aligned to the emirate's leadership
